title: Page 3
lines: 「有点意思啊。」龚昊天的笑意加深，接着递出黑卡。「请用。」
如斯伸手去拿，可是她抽了两次抽不动，知道是他故意拿着不放，她没好气的抬眼看向他，正好跌入他好整以暇等着的挑衅目光之中。
「怕信用卡被刷爆吗？」她发自内心微微一笑。嚣张的人种也有怕的一天？
龚昊天静静盯着她，眸色转深，好看唇形跟着她的笑容微微上扬。
不错喔！在他注视下还能出口反击，不像公司里无胆的员工们，只是被他盯着看，说话就会忍不住结巴。
想到这里，他的嘴角不自觉又上扬两度，松开手，眼中闪烁着戏谑的光芒。
「他的信用卡怎么可能被刷爆，我说你不知道他是谁就不要乱说话，老子光听就满肚子火。」卷发男气得跳脚。
如斯把信用卡交给今晚负责结帐的柜台人员。
柜台人员见气氛不对，加快速度完成刷卡后，恭敬的用双手把信用卡递还回去。
龚昊天看而不取，双眼直勾勾盯着如斯。
如斯意会一笑，挑了挑眉，单手从柜台人员手中拿过信用卡，顺势送到他眼皮子底下。
见他终于肯伸手来拿，如斯神秘一笑，趁他微微一愣之际，将信用卡转了个弯，直接放进他西装外套胸前的口袋里，接着再微微倾身向前。
看着这一幕，所有人都忍不住屏住了呼吸，全场只有龚昊天感到有趣而浅笑开来。
如斯贴近他耳边说了句话。
龚昊天一手被晾在半空中，听见她的话，右眉隐隐往上扬了几度，撇嘴一笑，看着她像个没事人，冲他笑着说谢谢光临。
一坐上跑车，跟龚昊天一起去结帐、绰号「鬼脑」的卷发男小声问道：「老大，刚刚那泼妇黏着你说了什么？」
龚昊天淡淡一笑，默然无语。
见他笑而不答，鬼脑摸摸鼻子，不再追问，只要老大不愿意说的事，谁都别想从他嘴里挖出一个字。
一群人笑笑闹闹的转战夜店，龚昊天去晃了一圈便提早离开。回到家后，如常洗澡上床，睡前一秒钟，脑中快速闪过伴随她身上淡淡清爽香气传来的话—
谢谢您对本餐厅营业额做出的贡献，附带提醒您一句，开车请多体谅路人，也请重视自己的生命。
一改往常快要九点大家才陆陆续续到齐，今天不到八点半，办公室内已经人声鼎沸。
如斯打上班卡时刚好八点半，还没移动，几名打扮比较简单朴素的员工便聚集到她身边。
「如斯，这是我们整理好的资料，等一下新老板发动攻击，你要多帮我们挡挡子弹啊！」
「谢谢你们，我尽量。」如斯虽是公关部经理，但从不让人喊她经理，不管是谁，一律喊她的名字。
「我花十分钟时间跟你大概讲一下重点，话说回来，我以为你今天会更早到。」如斯最得力的左右手小慧，边说话边滑开手中的平板。
「还不都是我妈，今天早上又莅临我的小窝，唠叨我要慢慢吃完早点再上班，一顿早饭我吃了半小时，她念了半小时。」自从发现她胃食道逆流后，老妈盯她吃早餐盯得很紧。
为了节省上下班时间，她在公司附近租了间小房子，老妈有时候会过来替她打扫，顺便监督她正常用餐，虽然她曾婉转的跟老妈说过不用这么辛苦，但老妈根本不听。
「你居然受得了？」小慧很快找到整理好的重点页。
「被念了二十几年，早有抗体。」如斯皱眉，鼻子敏感的嗅了嗅。「哈啾！什么味道这么浓烈？」
「行销部在楼下集合后，早你两秒钟刚飘进大会议室，感觉像一大瓶的移动式香水。」小慧很了如斯想问什么。
公司租下这栋菁英商业大楼的十七、十八、十九三层楼。
十七楼是行销部和业务部，十八楼是公关部和形象规划部，十九楼足足有两百多坪是老板专属的办公室，办公室外设有舒适的等候室，以及宛如门神坐镇的两名秘书办公空间。
十七楼有二十间小型会议室，十八楼只有一间会议室，却是能容纳百人以上的大型会议室。
十九楼为了避免闲杂人等走动，没有设有任何会议室。
「不知道是不是感情太好，你们会不会觉得行销部的人长得越来越像？」小慧困惑皱眉。
「怎么能不像？古人感情好是不求同年同月同日生，但求同年同月同日死，他们是不求同年同月同日生，但求同眼同鼻同医生。」一名长相古锥的男同事阿杰小小声回应。
此话一出，引起众人一阵轻笑，如斯轻咳一声，淡淡扫视大家一眼，顿时四周安静下来。
「里面有个写着今天日期的档案夹，把里头所有文件都列印出来。」她把一个随身碟交给其中一名下属后，快速交代道，「新老板Chris昨天发英文信通知，今早九点十分准时开会，我们九点进会议室就可以，昨天我整理了一份公司这五年来大概营运走向，内容不多，大家花二十分钟应该能消化完，抓紧时间赶快看。」
「是。」属下们异口同声地回道，接着回到各自的座位临时抱佛脚埋头苦读。
阿杰背得痛不欲生，直嚷着联考都没这么折磨过他。
其实不是他们不愿意提早做准备，而是他们前两天才得知公司换老板。
九点整，如斯和部门员工一起踏进会议室，此时会议室内的右半边已经坐满十七楼的同事们。
蒋婷悦穿着和于舞能昨晚穿的一模一样的最新款香奈儿白色洋装，坐在右边最靠近前台主位的位子，冷冷盯着如斯。
蒋婷悦上周才进公司，还是靠关系进来的，据说那时候公司已经确定卖给新老板。
面对流言，大家没怎么相信，毕竟有谁会特地靠关系进入一间刚易主的公司？怕好不容易挤进公司，新老板一声令下就人事改版，刚进来又得滚出去，谁会吃饱没事瞎忙一场？
所以面对蒋婷悦时，大家反而小心翼翼，因为所有人更愿意相信蒋婷悦是新老板的侦察兵。
蒋婷悦先进公司来明查暗访哪些人是冗员，只等新老板一上任，她就能拿出裁员名单，喀嚓一声，断人生计。
「听说有人觉得我们十七楼的人都长得很像？」见十八楼的人都坐定，新老板还没进来，十七楼一名把脸整得膨膨的组长率先开炮。
「长得像或不像有什么关系？重点是有人常年不恋爱，也不知道是哪里出了问题？」另一名十七楼膨膨脸看着如斯，讪笑道。
「我们如斯一点问题也没有，她是因为专注工作才没时间交男朋友，不像某些人进同一家工厂维修，别人是情同姊妹，有人是脸同姊妹。」小慧听见对方拐弯抹角讽刺自家主管，忍不住跳出来说话。
如斯想阻止小慧逞口舌之快，无奈小慧反应之快，一眨眼功夫，一串话就如倒豆子般飘出口。
「乏人问津就乏人问津，扯什么专注工作？」蒋婷悦冷笑道。
打从进公司后，说不出具体为什么，她就看孙如斯很不顺眼，好像两人天生犯冲，如果在其他地方，她可能会稍微收敛，但新任老板跟她熟识，给了她底气，而且她也有自信，将来就算她跟孙如斯PK，新任老板也会看在两人的交情上，站在她这一边。
这时，一道低沉嗓音从会议室门口传来—
「大家一早就很有活力啊！」
content_en:
"It's interesting." Gong Haotian's smile deepened and he handed over the black card. "Please use it."
She reached out to take it, but she couldn't move it after two twitches. Knowing that he was holding it on purpose, she looked up at him angrily, and fell right into the provocative gaze he had been waiting for.
"Are you afraid that your credit card will be maxed out?" She smiled from the bottom of her heart. Will the arrogant race be afraid one day?
Gong Haotian stared at her quietly, his eyes darkened, and his beautiful lips rose slightly following her smile.
Not bad! Under his gaze, you can still fight back, unlike the fearless employees in the company who can't help but stutter when they are just stared at by him.
Thinking of this, the corners of his mouth unconsciously raised twice more, and he let go of his hand, with a playful light shining in his eyes.
"How could his credit card be maxed out? I said if you don't know who he is, don't talk nonsense. Just hearing that makes me angry." The curly-haired man jumped in anger.
So hand your credit card to the person at the checkout counter tonight.
The counter staff saw that the atmosphere was not right, and after speeding up the credit card swiping process, they respectfully handed the credit card back with both hands.
Gong Haotian looked at it without taking it, staring straight at this.
Rusi smiled knowingly, raised his eyebrows, took the credit card from the counter staff with one hand, and put it under his nose.
Seeing that he was finally willing to reach out to take it, she smiled mysteriously, took advantage of him being slightly stunned, turned the credit card around, put it directly into the breast pocket of his suit jacket, and then leaned forward slightly.
Looking at this scene, everyone couldn't help but hold their breath. Only Gong Haotian in the audience felt amused and smiled.
She spoke so close to his ear.
Gong Haotian's hand was hanging in the air. When he heard her words, his right eyebrow slightly raised a few degrees, he curled his lips and smiled. He looked at her like she was fine, smiled at him and said thank you for coming.
As soon as he got into the sports car and went to check out with Gong Haotian, the curly-haired man nicknamed "Ghost Brain" asked in a low voice: "Boss, what did that shrew say when she clung to you just now?"
Gong Haotian smiled faintly and remained speechless.
Seeing him smiling but not answering, Gui Nao rubbed his nose and asked no more questions. As long as the boss didn't want to say anything, no one could get a word out of his mouth.
A group of people went to the nightclub laughing and noisy. Gong Haotian went to hang out and left early. After returning home, I took a shower and went to bed as usual. A second before going to bed, the words accompanying the light and refreshing fragrance of her body flashed through my mind -
Thank you for your contribution to the turnover of our restaurant. I would like to remind you, please be more considerate of passers-by when driving, and please also value your own life.
Changed from the usual time when everyone started to arrive one after another at almost nine o'clock. Today, before eight thirty, the office was already bustling with people.
It was exactly 8:30 when she punched in her work card, and before she could move, several employees dressed simply and plainly gathered around her.
"So, this is the information we have compiled. When the new boss launches his attack, you have to help us block more bullets!"
"Thank you, I'll try my best." Although she is the manager of the public relations department, she is never called manager. No matter who she is, she is always called by her name.
"I'll spend ten minutes talking to you briefly about the key points. Having said that, I thought you would arrive earlier today." Xiaohui, the most powerful right-hand man, slid the tablet in his hand as he spoke.
"It's not all my mother. She came to my nest again this morning, nagging me to eat breakfast slowly before going to work. I ate breakfast for half an hour, and she read for half an hour." Ever since she discovered her gastroesophageal reflux, her mother has been watching her eat breakfast very closely.
In order to save time on commuting, she rented a small house near the company. Her mother would sometimes come over to clean it for her and supervise her regular meals. Although she had tactfully told her mother that she didn't have to work so hard, her mother didn't listen at all.
"You can actually bear it?" Xiaohui quickly found the organized key pages.
"I have been studying for more than 20 years, and I have already developed antibodies." He frowned and sniffed with a sensitive nose. "Hello! What smells so strong?"
"After the marketing department gathered downstairs, it just floated into the big conference room two seconds before you. It felt like a big bottle of portable perfume." Xiaohui was very clear about what she wanted to ask.
The company rented the 17th, 18th and 19th floors of this elite commercial building.
The seventeenth floor is the marketing department and the business department, the eighteenth floor is the public relations department and the image planning department, and the nineteenth floor is the boss's exclusive office of more than 200 square meters. There is a comfortable waiting room outside the office, as well as the office space of two secretaries who are like door gods.
There are twenty small conference rooms on the seventeenth floor, and there is only one conference room on the eighteenth floor, but it is a large conference room that can accommodate more than a hundred people.
There are no meeting rooms on the 19th floor to prevent people from wandering around.
"I wonder if the relationship is too good. Do you think the people in the marketing department look more and more alike?" Xiaohui frowned in confusion.
"How could it be different? The ancients didn't want to be born in the same year, the same month and the same day, but they wanted to die on the same year, the same month, and the same day. They didn't want to be born in the same year, the same month, the same day, but they wanted the same eyes, the same nose, and the same doctor." Ajie, a male colleague who looked like an old man, responded in a low voice.
As soon as these words came out, everyone chuckled. He coughed lightly and glanced at everyone, and the surroundings suddenly became quiet.
"There is a folder with today's date written on it. Print out all the documents in it." After handing a flash drive to one of her subordinates, she quickly explained, "The new boss Chris sent an English letter yesterday to inform that the meeting will begin at 9:10 this morning. We can just enter the conference room at 9 o'clock. Yesterday, I compiled a general operation direction of the company in the past five years. There is not much content. It should take everyone 20 minutes to digest it, so hurry up and read it quickly."
"Yes." The subordinates replied in unison, and then returned to their respective seats to study hard.
Ajie's back hurt so much that he complained that the joint entrance examination had never tortured him like this.
In fact, it's not that they don't want to prepare in advance, but that they only learned about the company's new owner two days ago.
At nine o'clock sharp, Su walked into the conference room with department employees. At this time, the right half of the conference room was already filled with colleagues from the 17th floor.
Jiang Tingyue was wearing the same latest Chanel white dress that Yu Wuneng wore last night. She was sitting on the right side closest to the main seat at the front desk, staring coldly at this.
Jiang Tingyue only joined the company last week, and she came in through connections. It is said that the company had already been sold to the new owner by then.
In the face of rumors, everyone didn't believe it. After all, who would rely on connections to enter a company that has just changed hands? I'm afraid that after finally squeezing into the company, the new boss will make personnel changes at the first order, and he will have to get out as soon as he comes in. Who will have nothing to eat and work around?
So when facing Jiang Tingyue, everyone was cautious because everyone was more willing to believe that Jiang Tingyue was a scout for the new boss.
Jiang Tingyue went to the company to investigate and secretly investigate who were redundant employees. As soon as the new boss took office, she could come up with the layoff list and cut off people's livelihoods with a click.
"I heard that some people think that the people on the 17th floor all look alike?" Seeing that everyone on the 18th floor was sitting down and the new boss hadn't come in yet, a team leader on the 17th floor who had made his face puffy took the lead.
"What does it matter whether they look alike or not? The point is that there are people who haven't been in love all year round and don't know what's wrong?" Another person on the 17th floor looked at this with a swollen face and said with a smile.
"We don't have any problem at all. She has no time to have a boyfriend because she is focused on work. It's not like some people who go to the same factory for maintenance. Others are sisters in love, and some are sisters in face." Xiaohui heard the other person sarcastic about her supervisor in a roundabout way, and couldn't help but jump out and speak.
He wanted to stop Xiao Hui from using his quick words, but Xiao Hui reacted quickly. In the blink of an eye, a string of words flowed out of his mouth like beans.
"If no one cares, there will be no care. Why focus on work?" Jiang Tingyue sneered.
Ever since she joined the company, she couldn't explain the specific reason, but she felt disliked by Sun Rusi, as if the two were naturally at odds with each other. If she were in other places, she might have restrained herself a little, but the new boss knew her well, which gave her confidence, and she was also confident that even if she competed with Sun Rusi in the future, the new boss would consider their friendship and stand on her side.
At this time, a deep voice came from the door of the conference room—
"Everyone is very energetic early in the morning!"
